title: PH gov’t urged to protect Luzon Economic Corridor infrastructure
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine government should protect telecommunications, power, water and transportation networks as strategic national assets in developing the Luzon Economic Corridor…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine government should protect telecommunications, power, water and transportation networks as strategic national assets in developing the Luzon Economic Corridor (LEC), as disruptions could undermine economic growth and national security, Stratbase Institute said.
